item.title: Several inches of snow falls on Cape; temperatures going above-freezing this week
item.description: HYANNIS – A snowy winter continued this weekend on Cape Cod. The National Weather Service reported two-to-three inches of snow on Saturday across portions of the Cape, with a top total of three-point-five inches in Truro. Bourne also got three inches, while Falmouth and Hyannis had two. item.title: Marine Biological Lab will be independent again after university affiliation
item.description: WOODS HOLE – The Marine Biological Laboratory in Woods Hole has ended a twelve-year affiliation with the University of Chicago. The MBL, which was founded in 1888, says it will once again be a fully independent organization effective June 30th.
